answer:
Yes — Cormorant Mobile Detailing in San Francisco can do this.

They are mobile-only ("We come to you!"), work on vans, and offer The Skiff — exterior-only wash: foam hand wash, wheels and tires, door jambs, outside glass and hand dry. "This one doesn't touch the inside."

Fit for your request:
- 3x Ford Transit full-size vans = Class D on their price board. Skiff Class D is $139 per van. 3 x $139 = $417 all-in for the wash itself, before any multi-car discount.
- Saturday: they work Tuesday to Saturday, closed Sunday/Monday. Saturday is morning arrival window only: 8:00am to 9:30am. Tue-Fri also has 1:00-2:30pm.
- At your lot: vehicle can be in driveway, private lot, open garage or legal street space with 3ft clear both sides, plus room for their work van within 100ft.
- For 3+ vehicles they need a working water spigot within 100ft — their tank only covers up to 2 vehicles. The Skiff needs no power, so no $30 generator fee.
- $50 booking deposit counts toward your total. No travel fee is listed for San Francisco — page says "We're based in San Francisco. We also travel further for a fee, see the map." 94103 SoMa is in the base zone.

Others found can't do it:
- Peninsula Suds — "Not serving San Francisco at this time"
- Sunset Shine Auto Spa — drop your car off at shop, not mobile
- Ferry Point Auto Care — partner parking garages only

To book: call/text 415-555-0142, office Mon-Sat 8am-6pm. Need 24hrs notice before window. Ask about multi-car discount when you book — homepage says "Got more than one car... Ask about discounts" but no amount is published, so $417 could drop. Also confirm if 1x $50 deposit covers all 3 vans or is per-van, and that you have a spigot available.
